External public source files used by the key-variables stage (downloaded 2026-10-01).
CPIAUCNS.csv          FRED: CPI-U all items, US city average, NSA, monthly (BLS series CUUR0000SA0)
CUUR0000SAF11.csv     FRED: CPI-U food at home, NSA, monthly
CUUR0000SETB01.csv    FRED: CPI-U gasoline (all types), NSA, monthly
hhs_poverty_guidelines.xlsx  ASPE/HHS "Historical Poverty Guidelines Through 2026"
hhs_poverty_guidelines_48states.csv  parsed: 48 contiguous states, 2000-2021, p1..p8 and $ per additional person
